title: Cyprus 2026: statutory rules, measured statistics and modelling assumptions

parameters.label: Employee Social Insurance contribution
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; employed persons (general rule)
parameters.evidence: "22.8%, of which 8.8% is paid by the employee, 8.8% by the employer and 5.2% from the Consolidated Fund … contribution year beginning on or after 1st of January 2024"
parameters.explanation: Employees in a non-contributory occupational pension scheme have a different split (4.45/13.15/5.2), not modelled.

parameters.label: Employer Social Insurance contribution
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; employers of employed persons
parameters.evidence: see si.employeeRate
parameters.explanation: Paid by the employer to the Social Insurance Fund.

parameters.label: State Social Insurance contribution (employees)
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; paid by the Consolidated Fund for employed persons
parameters.evidence: see si.employeeRate
parameters.explanation: A government transfer to the Fund; NOT part of the employer's labour cost.

parameters.label: Self-employed Social Insurance contribution
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; self-employed persons
parameters.evidence: "21.8%, of which 16.6% is paid by the self-employed and 5.2% from the Consolidated Fund … 2024"; Table II "CONTR. PERC. 16,6%"
parameters.explanation: Insurable income is at least an occupational-category minimum (€331.14–€982.38/week in 2026).

parameters.label: State Social Insurance contribution (self-employed)
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; self-employed
parameters.evidence: see si.selfEmployedRate
parameters.explanation: Government transfer to the Fund on self-employed insurable income; not paid by the self-employed person.

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, monthly-paid employees
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; per employee per monthly pay period
parameters.evidence: "(β) Ανώτατο όριο για μηνιαίους εργοδοτούμενους: €5.742 από 1/1/2026"
parameters.explanation: Applied per employee and per pay period; never to total payroll.

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, weekly-paid employees
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; per employee per weekly pay period; also self-employed weekly maximum
parameters.evidence: "(α) Ανώτατο όριο για εβδομαδιαίους εργοδοτούμενους: €1.325 από 5/1/2026"
parameters.explanation: Per employee per weekly pay period; the weekly maximum also bounds self-employed insurable income (52 × €1,325 = €68,900/year).

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, annual (reference)
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; = 12 × monthly ceiling
parameters.evidence: "€1.325 per week, €5.742 per month and €68.904 per annum" (KPMG). Official notice gives only weekly/monthly limits.
parameters.explanation: Not stated in any official page found; equals 12 × €5,742 (52 × €1,325 = €68,900). Calculations use the per-period ceilings.

parameters.label: Basic insurable earnings
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; basis for self-employed minimums and benefits
parameters.evidence: "Εβδομαδιαίο ποσό βασικών ασφαλιστέων αποδοχών € … 220.76"
parameters.explanation: Reference amount for self-employed minimum insurable income (× occupational coefficient 1.5–4.45) and for benefits.

parameters.label: Discount factor β (primary structural assumption)
parameters.coverage: Cyprus model (Level 2)
parameters.explanation: Primary assumption (paper value). NOT independently established as Cyprus's behavioural discount factor, and it does NOT match the 2023 capital/output target (implied K/Y 5.70 vs 2.89 observed). The alternative calibration β = 0.922 matches K/Y but implies an 8.4% net after-tax return; neither is an empirical estimate of Cyprus preferences.
